company: Aven offers a home-equity-backed credit card designed to give homeowners a lower-cost alternative to high-interest revolving credit.
The company announced a $110 million Series E at a $2.2 billion valuation in September 2025.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Aven sits at the intersection of consumer credit, home equity, and fintech underwriting. Its model is a useful indicator of whether private lenders can use household balance sheets to compete with conventional card economics.
